subject: accordion
pitch:
Category: Object.
Subject: piano accordion.
Style: Italian mother-of-pearl.

requests.what: Raised Italian mother-of-pearl rosette on the front of the right shell: concentric ivory, aqua, rose and gold petals with a dark outline, kept crisp and symmetrical.
Ornate Italian floral filigree emblem on the left bass shell, a large cream and turquoise curling vine with three pearl flowers and tiny brass studs.
Tiny mother-of-pearl nameplate above the piano keys reading ACCORDI ITALIANI, with a thin gold border and two red jewel end caps.
A rich array of twelve bass buttons in four staggered rows: alternating ivory pearl, turquoise pearl and ruby-red buttons, each with a tiny brass bezel.
Gold corner guards and dark burgundy leather end bindings on every bellows fold, with tiny punched brass rivets; preserve the fold rhythm.
Decorative speaker grille on the lower right shell: a rounded gold frame, turquoise lattice, and a dark inset behind it, centered below the rosette.
Two broad burgundy leather shoulder straps emerging from the rear shell, with cream stitching, brass buckles, and padded pearl-colored shoulder sections.
Four ruby cabochons in small brass bezels at the shell corners, plus matching turquoise cabochons on the opposite shell.
Paint the bellows folds as alternating deep burgundy leather and warm wine-red bands, with subtle cream pinstripes following every ridge.
Italian mother-of-pearl mosaic: pale ivory base with irregular aqua, blush-pink and champagne facets, restrained gold veining, and a soft dark edge shadow.
Match the left shell with a coordinated mother-of-pearl mosaic, but keep the central rosette area visually clear for the emblem request.
Fine burgundy leather grain and repeated cream saddle stitching on all strap pieces and their folded tabs.
